rollback_before_database_apply: Revert the Phase 03 squash commit or remove the additive migration in a corrective PR.
Verify legacy Prisma schema and public production remain unchanged.
rollback_after_future_database_apply: Do not drop schemas automatically if any data has been written.
Use the database-specific backup/migration receipt captured immediately before apply.
Prefer forward corrective migration when data exists.
Verify tenant integrity and application behavior after recovery.
data_loss_risk: none while migration is unapplied; must be reassessed immediately before any live database apply
